metadata.annotation_status: AI-assisted source-grounded provisional gold; not independently human-validated
metadata.selection: 12 new source-supported scenarios selected by document coverage and answer clarity, before any retrieval ranking or generator output; 3 per category
metadata.exclusions: All 20 scenario_ids in condition_eval/test_questions.json and all 3 in condition_eval/development.json; no same-scenario paraphrases
metadata.gold_access: Scoring-only: reference_answers, required_slots, allowed_extras, critical_errors, and relevant_evidence must never enter retrieval, packing, or generation.
metadata.construct: One necessary operational condition or key constraint per question; behavior_explanation is explicitly distinguished from prerequisites.
metadata.slot_scoring_context: Judge the full answer together with the question context. Do not require restating already-given context; correct commands and paths can implement constraints. Acceptable strings are semantic examples, not exhaustive keyword patterns.
metadata.prior_data_exposure: Prior formal questions and the development JSON were read for exclusion; development reference fields were inadvertently visible because they share the same file. Old formal gold.json, predictions, result files, rankings, and generator outputs were not read for this dataset.

changes: Aligned holdout gold top-level records key to items, as required by condition_experiment.validate_gold.
Separated each single short-answer target from explanation; all substantive information needs remain before the literal 简短答案 retrieval suffix.
pre_freeze_revision.stage: Pre-freeze, before any retrieval ranking or generator output; scenarios, reference answers, slots and evidence unchanged.

metadata.output_contract: short_answer contains only the requested single command/flag/path/expression/name; requested conditions belong in explanation. All substantive needs precede 简短答案.
